label: Rescue
description: Someone is taken. Bring them back before it's too late.

beats.label: The Taking
beats.directive: Show who is lost, what they mean to the protagonist, and who took them.
fallbackChoices: Find out where they were taken

beats.label: The Trail
beats.directive: Pick up the trail and win help or information from someone along the way.

beats.label: Obstacle
beats.directive: The way is blocked and time runs short; earlier choices decide what help is left.

beats.label: Hard Truth
beats.directive: Learn why the captive was really taken; the rescue now means facing something worse.
fallbackChoices: Change the plan to match the truth

beats.label: The Rescue
beats.directive: Reach the captive and face the captor. Choices are final, decisive moves.

beats.label: Homecoming
beats.directive: Show who comes home and how they are changed; the outcome reflects the path taken. Offer no choices.
